meta.source: Chaos Zero Nightmare build 133 SSRA/DB export
meta.confidence: interactive battle model with explicit approximations
caveats: The client battle runtime is compiled bytecode; edge-case ordering and some formula branches are not fully recovered.
Damage is an intentionally transparent approximation for relative comparisons, not a replacement for an in-game damage readout.
Conditions that cannot be evaluated from the current event model are reported in the battle log instead of silently treated as true.

text.relic@s1_description@eq_chr_ca_024: A phonograph containing records that the Heretic Interrogator once listened to.
text.relic@s1_description@eq_chr_ca_025: Blood carried by a heretic. It's unclear whether it was donated or offered.
text.relic@s1_description@eq_chr_ca_026: The pattern is unusually ornamental for something that was once used in a butcher shop. It looks like it could slice through anything.
text.relic@s1_description@eq_chr_ca_027: Clothing worn by a heretic. It could be useful as a disguise.
text.relic@s1_description@eq_dll_ca_011: A standard radio carried by Dark Star, taken on a hunch that it might come in handy.
text.relic@s1_description@eq_dll_ca_012: A chip containing emotional data collected by the Black Angels. It is marked with 'Sample Classification: Excellent. Requires Re-observation.'
text.relic@s1_description@eq_dll_ca_013: A self-defense manual carried by Dark Star. It doesn't seem to have been very helpful.
text.relic@s1_description@eq_dll_ca_014: Bolts and nuts that fell from somewhere on the Black Angel's body.
text.relic@s1_description@eq_dll_ca_015: A stimulant carried by Dark Star. It appears highly effective.
text.relic@s1_description@eq_inv_ca_010: An unidentified sauce stored in a leather pouch. It has a sweet yet unusual scent.
text.relic@s1_description@eq_inv_ca_011: Slime the Nest's heart secreted after overreacting to purple dust, now hardened and faintly sweet-smelling.
text.relic@s1_description@eq_inv_ca_012: Spore powder collected from a giant mushroom. It induces a hazy sensation.
text.relic@s1_description@eq_inv_ca_013: Essence cherished by an Invader. Not yet fully condensed.
text.relic@s1_description@eq_inv_ca_014: Invader-made honey. Its taste is divisive, but it's apparently quite addictive once you get hooked.
text.relic@s1_description@eq_nih_ca_012: A grip trainer used by a space pirate. It might be useful someday with consistent training.
text.relic@s1_description@eq_nih_ca_013: A lump of prey that stopped digesting inside an overfed monster. Certain things are better off unknown.
text.relic@s1_description@eq_nih_ca_014: An eyeball that could not be digested. Its original owner is unknown.
text.relic@s1_description@eq_nih_ca_015: A drink the researcher was never without. The taste is a mystery, but the stimulating effect is undeniable.
text.relic@s1_description@eq_nih_ca_016: A jump starter a Moss Robot carried for emergencies. It looks slightly worn.
text.relic@s1_description@eq_sec_ca_014: A poacher's slingshot that doesn't seem capable of killing anything. It looks useless, but was taken anyway.
text.relic@s1_description@eq_sec_ca_015: A plant root that screams wildly, swaying side to side.
text.relic@s1_description@eq_sec_ca_016: A trap used to capture countless spirits. It's impossible to tell how many it has caught.
text.relic@s1_description@eq_sec_ca_017: Sap extracted from an evil spirit. Its dense black color makes it suitable for dye.
text.relic@s1_description@eq_sec_ca_018: An employee ID card belonging to a Dark Star researcher. They look exhausted from working overnight.
